categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Touches blockstorage and chainstate flush handling in src/node/blockstorage.cpp and src/validation.cpp, with no relation to mempool policy, tx acceptance, or relay.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes block and undo file flush handling in src/node/blockstorage.cpp and src/validation.cpp, covered under block and undo file storage and chainstate integrity.
categories.rationale: Hardens the flush-error notification invariant to ensure failed block or undo file flushes reliably trigger node shutdown. As noted in the description, callers rely on the invariant that a fatal flush error notification has fired, but it previously depended on individual branches remembering to invoke it; this centralizes the check to prevent future flush branches from silently failing without an AbortNode.
